defs.def: a rough written version of sth that is not yet in its final form 草稿；草案；草图

ex.s: After you have revised your draft until it is too messy to work from anymore, you can enter your changes into your word processor.
ex.t: 在你的初稿被修改得过于凌乱无法继续使用之后，你可以把修改内容输入文字处理器。

ex.s: The second draft of the essay should be better.
ex.t: 作文的第二稿应该更好。

ex.s: Then you can print out a fresh draft, again setting your text on triple-space.
ex.t: 然后你可以打印出一份新的草稿，再次将文本设置为三倍行距。

ex.s: March 9 Submit a final draft of your essay．
ex.t: 3月9日 提交你作文的终稿。

ex.s: The draft resolution will be brought to the floor for debate at an MUN conference.
ex.t: 该决议草案将被提交给模拟联合国大会进行辩论。

ex.s: Drafting a picture If you haven’t already heard of Fanjing Mountain, you soon will!
ex.t: 画草图 如果你还没听说过梵净山，你很快就会听说的！

defs.def: a written order to a bank to pay money to sb 汇票
a system in which professional teams in some sports choose players each year from among college students 运动员选拔制（某些职业运动队每年在大学生中选拔新队员）

ex.s: MUN, or Model United Nations, is an opportunity for students to learn about diplomatic relations and write a draft resolution to solve issues concerning the international community.
ex.t: 模拟联合国（MUN）是一个让学生了解外交关系并撰写决议草案以解决国际社会问题的机会。

defs.def: 你关上门好吗？这里有穿堂风。
to write the first rough version of sth such as a letter, speech or book 起草；草拟

ex.s: Think of your first draft as a path cut out of the jungle—as part of an exploration, not as a complete highway.
ex.t: 把你的初稿想象成一条从丛林中开辟出来的小路——作为探索的一部分，而不是一条完整的高速公路。

ex.s: Too many writers try to get their drafts right the first time.
ex.t: 太多作家试图一次就把初稿写好。

ex.s: The next technique is to write your draft rapidly without worrying about being perfect.
ex.t: 下一种技巧是快速写初稿，不必追求完美。

ex.s: Benjamin Franklin (1706-1790) was one of the Founding Fathers of the Fathers of the United States and helped draft the Declaration of Independence.
ex.t: 本杰明·富兰克林（1706-1790）是美国开国元勋之一，曾协助起草《独立宣言》。

ex.s: Now think about how well you understood the features of a lecture, and what you should pay attention to when drafting a lecture.
ex.t: 现在想想你对讲座特点的理解程度，以及在起草讲座时应该注意什么。

defs.def: to choose people and send them somewhere for a special task 选派；抽调

ex.s: “I was turning the page to get ready for the next page, but the draft wind from the turn caused the spare pages to fall off the stand,” Mr Titterton said, “Luckily I was able to catch them and put them back.”
ex.t: “我在翻页准备下一页时，”蒂特顿先生说，“翻页带起的气流把多余的乐谱从谱架上吹落了，幸好我接住了它们并把它们放回去。”
